summary: Iteration 14 tested URL alignment with live purepeptide.bg, new page slugs, /link-index, SEO endpoints (sitemap.xml, agents.md, sitemap_agentic_discovery.xml, robots.txt), delisted-links cleanup, storefront navigation, retatrutide collection visibility, admin bulk-translate status, and admin collections/content editor. 22/22 backend pytest cases pass. 12/16 frontend checks pass. One critical routing bug found: sub-pages /pages/html-sitemap-{products,collections,blogs,pages} are captured by the generic /pages/:slug route and rendered by StaticPage instead of HtmlSitemapPage - React Router v6 does not support partial-path dynamic segments (`html-sitemap-:kind`). The hub page /pages/html-sitemap itself works and shows all 4 sitemap-hub-links. Admin collections/content editor has every required data-testid and the bulk-translate button/status are visible with a job running (1/62 -> product: sermorelin).

ui_bugs.issue: Route pattern '/pages/html-sitemap-:kind' does not match URLs like /pages/html-sitemap-products because React Router v6 requires an entire path segment for dynamic params. As a result StaticPage catches these URLs and shows a bare 'html-sitemap-products' slug page with no sitemap-list. Fix: change to '/pages/html-sitemap/:kind' (and update HUB links + backend sitemap.xml URLs) OR register 4 explicit routes for products/collections/blogs/pages, OR detect the slug inside StaticPage and delegate to HtmlSitemapPage.

The ONLY remaining bug is the html-sitemap-:kind route pattern in /app/frontend/src/App.js line 46 — after main agent fixes routing, re-run the 4 frontend checks for /pages/html-sitemap-products, -collections, -blogs, -pages expecting data-testid='sitemap-list' with >0 links.
rca of the issue: React Router v6 tokenises each URL segment at '/' boundaries. A route path segment can be either fully literal ('foo') or a single param ('/:foo'), but NOT 'foo-:bar'. When '/pages/html-sitemap-:kind' is registered, RRv6 treats the entire second segment literally as the string 'html-sitemap-:kind' (which no URL will match), so the router falls back to '/pages/:slug' → StaticPage, giving a bare page with just the slug as title. Reproduction: open /pages/html-sitemap-products → title shows 'html-sitemap-products' and no [data-testid=sitemap-list] element exists. Mitigation: use '/pages/html-sitemap/:kind' (and update HUB links in HtmlSitemapPage.jsx plus the URLs emitted in backend sitemap.xml), or list four explicit routes '/pages/html-sitemap-products' … each pointing at <HtmlSitemapPage />.
